paragraphs.text: The Stonehaven Plains are plains in Stonehaven , the western part of Corondor on the plane of Dominaria .

The Stonehaven Plains are the heartland of southern Stonehaven . A quiet, peaceful place, and one of the few places that had been spared the horrors of the Planeswalker War . A home for farmers and gentle scholars, even its resident ghost inspires sympathy rather than terror.
